description: Report a match result (organizer step 5, on match day; needs manage_code). Recording a score advances the winner into the next round automatically and returns where they advanced to. Pass undo=true with the match_id to revert a result (cascades to auto-filled downstream slots). Overwriting an existing result is logged as a correction.

match_id.description: e.g. M1 (the player page's label for the match; legacy R1M1-style ids are also accepted)

score_sets.description: Optional structured per-set scores, written in parallel with the display string `score` (the display string keeps its own semantics). Each item is an object {p1: integer, p2: integer, tb?: [integer, integer]}, e.g. [{"p1": 6, "p2": 4}, {"p1": 7, "p2": 6, "tb": [7, 5]}], where tb is the optional tie-break points [p1, p2]. Stored in the match object and used to report results back to DUPR (required for rated events; the referee scoring UI blocks confirmation without it). Omitting it on an overwrite PRESERVES the existing score_sets (unlike `score`); pass an empty array [] to explicitly clear it, or a full array to replace it.

p1.description: points/games won by the player in slot p1 in this set

p2.description: points/games won by the player in slot p2 in this set

tb.description: optional tie-break score [p1, p2], exactly two integers

undo.description: Set true (with match_id; winner/score not needed) to revert that match's result and its downstream effects

winner.description: exact player name as in the bracket (spelling must match)

name: report_result
